pid.cmt:
PID Simulation
To activate the PID loop change the bit TEST_PID to true and change the PID_SP (setpoint) variable to a value between 0 and 100.
There is a floating average block below the PID block that feeds the PID output back into the PID input
at a delayed rate to simulate a real-world delay.

To test auto-tuning simply turn on the bit PID_StartAT bit while the block is active. Starting values are applied with the first run bit.
